items.text_en: Auroville, India. Indigenous species, water retention earthworks, volunteers, and published survival rates. The direct model.
items.text_hr: Auroville, Indija. Autohtone vrste, zemljani radovi za vodu, volonteri i objavljene stope preživljavanja. Izravan model.

items.text_en: The township founded on Sri Aurobindo's Integral Yoga, and its free progress schools. Seven years of Marko's life.
items.text_hr: Grad utemeljen na Integralnoj yogi Sri Aurobinda i njegove free progress škole. Sedam godina Markova života.

items.text_en: Dry stone craft, workshops since 2002, and the open public inventory suhozid.hr.
items.text_hr: Suhozidni zanat, radionice od 2002. i otvoreni javni inventar suhozid.hr.

items.text_en: Sabine Engelhardt's eco smallholding on Brač. Permaculture, eco architecture, geomancy in the Marko Pogačnik lineage, charity since 2011.
items.text_hr: Ekološko imanje Sabine Engelhardt na Braču. Permakultura, eko arhitektura, geomantija u tradiciji Marka Pogačnika, udruga od 2011.

items.text_en: Petrova gora. Straw bale and cordwood houses, composting toilets, greywater treatment, permaculture. Croatian precedent.
items.text_hr: Petrova gora. Kuće od bala slame i drvenih oblica, kompostni zahodi, pročišćavanje sivih voda, permakultura. Hrvatski presedan.

items.text_en: Vukomerić, south of Zagreb. The other established Croatian permaculture site.
items.text_hr: Vukomerić, južno od Zagreba. Drugi uhodani hrvatski permakulturni teren.

items.text_en: Michael Reynolds. Fully decentralised houses for heat, cooling, water and power. We take the logic and leave the tyres, building instead in stone, wood, clay, straw and glass.
items.text_hr: Michael Reynolds. Potpuno decentralizirane kuće za grijanje, hlađenje, vodu i struju. Uzimamo logiku, ostavljamo gume, i gradimo kamenom, drvom, glinom, slamom i staklom.

items.text_en: Superadobe. Earth bag domes built from the ground they stand on, tested for earthquake and fire. Relevant because the bunja is the same idea in stone.
items.text_hr: Superadobe. Kupole od vreća zemlje građene od tla na kojem stoje, ispitane na potres i požar. Relevantno jer je bunja ista ideja u kamenu.

items.text_en: Long running European communities that solved the questions of governance, water and food before we asked them.
items.text_hr: Dugovječne europske zajednice koje su pitanja upravljanja, vode i hrane riješile prije nego smo ih mi postavili.

items.text_en: Mojave desert. An all wood domed chamber built without nails, cited here strictly as an acoustic architecture precedent.
items.text_hr: Pustinja Mojave. Drvena kupolasta dvorana građena bez čavala, navedena isključivo kao presedan akustične arhitekture.

items.text_en: Circle dances brought together by Samuel Lewis in the late 1960s from the sacred phrases of many traditions, led by a facilitator, open to anyone on the first evening.
items.text_hr: Kružni plesovi koje je Samuel Lewis krajem šezdesetih složio od svetih fraza mnogih tradicija, vodi ih voditelj, a otvoreni su svakome već prve večeri.

items.text_en: Partner practice of trust, weight and counterweight. Two people cannot fake it, which is why it belongs where people work together.
items.text_hr: Partnerska praksa povjerenja, težine i protuteže. Dvoje ljudi je ne mogu glumiti, zato pripada tamo gdje se radi zajedno.

items.text_en: Large gatherings that showed what temporary infrastructure, sound and shared work can build. We take the craft and leave the scale.
items.text_hr: Veliki skupovi koji su pokazali što privremena infrastruktura, zvuk i zajednički rad mogu izgraditi. Uzimamo zanat, ostavljamo mjerilo.
